glosses: The sport of the sport of climbing on rocks or in mountains, or on specially designed walls inside or outdoors.

examples.text: James never cared much for the sea-side, but developed a passionate love for the Westmoreland mountains, getting to know most of them as an energetic fell walker, preferring this to rock climbing.

glosses: present participle and gerund of rock climb
The sport of climbing, ascending a wall or a rock or another object using available holds, generally with the safety of a rope and belayer.

examples.text: The next day, the team had to wear special ice climbing footwear while repairing other research devices on the glacier.

glosses: present participle and gerund of climb
That climbs; that grows upwards by gripping onto a surface.

examples.text: . . . our rapidly increasing knowledge of the Rocky Mountains of Canada for which geography is so greatly indebted to alpinism.

examples.text: „Was die Erfahrung des Bergsteigens zu einer Metapher des Lebens überhaupt werden lässt und sogar noch zum Sinnbild für die Suche nach dem ewigen Seelenheil, ist die Verbindung der kulturell positiv besetzten Vorstellung der Höhe mit der Abforderung einer körperlichen Leistung.“
